sources.title: AstroLife original editorial synthesis
sources.use: Original plain-language summaries and reflective prompts written for this knowledge base. Not a quotation or claim of empirical proof.
sources.rights_note: Original cards are CC BY 4.0. External sources are separately listed and retain their own rights.

sources.title: JPL Horizons API documentation
sources.use: Independent comparison fixtures for solar-system positions and explicit ephemeris settings.
sources.rights_note: Use documented API outputs and retain query settings, version, timestamp and attribution. Do not imply JPL endorsement.

sources.title: The Constellations
sources.use: Astronomical distinction between constellation boundaries, star patterns and cultural sky traditions.
sources.rights_note: Link and cite the source; do not copy its images or page text into this dataset.

sources.title: Ptolemy's Tetrabiblos, translated by J. M. Ashmand
sources.use: Historical reference for classical astrological vocabulary and the history of traditional doctrine.
sources.rights_note: Project Gutenberg marks this edition public domain in the U.S. and asks readers elsewhere to check local law. This repository stores original summaries and a link, not the full translation.

sources.title: A double-blind test of astrology
sources.use: A controlled test of claims about natal charts and personality matching.
sources.rights_note: Bibliographic citation and high-level summary only; no reproduction of article text.

sources.title: Appraisal of Shawn Carlson's Renowned Astrology Tests
sources.use: A published critique and reanalysis of the 1985 Carlson study; demonstrates that the debate should not be oversimplified.
sources.rights_note: Bibliographic citation and high-level summary only; no reproduction of article text.

sources.title: Science versus the stars: a double-blind test of the validity of the NEO Five-Factor Inventory and computer-generated astrological natal charts
sources.use: A controlled test in which participants could identify their real NEO personality summaries above chance but could not identify their own computer-generated astrology summaries.
sources.rights_note: Bibliographic citation and high-level summary only; no reproduction of article text.

sources.title: Astronomy Engine
sources.use: The current AstroLife calculation provider and its documented assumptions; not a claim of NASA/JPL equivalence.
sources.rights_note: MIT license in the upstream repository. Preserve its license and attribution when distributing code.

sources.title: paraphrase-multilingual-MiniLM-L12-v2 model card
sources.use: Optional multilingual semantic-search experiment; not a mandatory runtime dependency.
sources.rights_note: Model card lists Apache-2.0 and 384-dimensional vectors across 50 languages. Review upstream dependencies before redistribution; do not bundle the large model in the default installer.

sources.title: Astro-Databank copyright and reuse policy
sources.use: Exclusion rule: no scraping or copying protected prose/images.
sources.rights_note: Astro-Databank explicitly prohibits spidering/scraping and reserves rights in its creative text and images.

sources.title: Swiss Ephemeris licensing information
sources.use: Exclusion rule until the project has selected and complied with a permitted license.
sources.rights_note: Dual AGPL/professional licensing. It is not included in this repository or bundled application by default.
